name: Troosolar
summary: A smart solar energy platform for monitoring solar systems, tracking energy generation and managing installations.
challenge: Solar owners needed a simpler way to manage their systems, use their energy better and rely less on traditional power, without juggling spreadsheets and installer reports.
solution: We built a complete solar management platform where users monitor panel performance, track energy generation and manage system data through a clean, easy interface.

features.title: Performance monitoring
features.text: See how each solar system is performing at a glance.

features.title: Energy tracking
features.text: Track energy generation over time to make better decisions.

features.title: Installation management
features.text: Keep system and installation data in one place.

features.title: Solar store
features.text: Browse and buy solar bundles and products online.

features.title: Multi-vendor stores
features.text: Sellers list products, manage inventory and process their own orders.

features.title: Social shopping

features.title: Secure accounts

solution: We built a multi-vendor platform with salon discovery and online booking for customers, a shop for professional products, and tools for salons to run bookings, payments, products and clients.

features.title: Salon discovery
